source: Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall. Observers are surprised by your spotlight on law and order, although the speech is well-received.
zh: 会议厅里欢呼声和嘲笑声交织在一起。尽管您的演讲很受欢迎，但观察人士对您对法律与秩序的关注感到惊讶。

source: This isn't bad, but it completely ignores the issue of Vietnam and does nothing to rebuke the notion that you will continue Johnson's policies there.
zh: 这还不错，但它完全忽略了越南问题，并且没有任何反驳你将继续在那里执行约翰逊政策的观念。

source: This is a good theme to carry through with on your campaign.
zh: 这是一个很好的主题，适合在您的活动中贯彻。

source: You realize Johnson quit because of his massive unpopularity, right? Pledging to continue his policies is not the best way to sell yourself this fall.
zh: 你意识到约翰逊退出是因为他非常不受欢迎，对吗？承诺继续执行他的政策并不是今年秋天推销自己的最佳方式。

source: Uniting your coalition is the first step towards getting yourself back into the race.
zh: 团结你的联盟是让你自己重返竞选的第一步。

source: It's a divisive issue, but on the balance Americans don't want to hear about plans to escalate the Vietnam War.
zh: 这是一个有分歧的问题，但总的来说，美国人不想听到升级越南战争的计划。

source: This is an acceptable answer to assuage Johnson and the Democratic establishment, but you’ve done nothing to win over disaffected doves.
zh: 这是安抚约翰逊和民主党建制派的一个可以接受的答案，但你没有采取任何措施来赢得心怀不满的鸽派人士的支持。

source: This looks to be a real turning point in your campaign. Your call for a bombing halt undercuts the argument that you are a stooge for LBJ, and it's definitely helping you bring the anti-war vote back.
zh: 这看起来是你的竞选活动中真正的转折点。你对停止轰炸的呼吁削弱了你是林登·约翰逊傀儡的论点，而且它肯定会帮助你恢复反战投票。

source: There is no denying that this answer helps you with the anti-war crowd, but it also exposes you to a lot of attacks.
zh: 不可否认，这个答案对你与反战人群有帮助，但它也让你面临很多攻击。

source: This is more extreme than what most people expect to hear from you. There are rumblings of discontent from black voters that you are selling them out.
zh: 这比大多数人期望从您那里听到的更加极端。黑人选民抱怨你出卖了他们。

source: This is an answer is that really is in tune with the country. However, liberals and blacks notice your evasiveness about civil rights.
zh: 这是一个真正符合国家要求的答案。然而，自由主义者和黑人注意到你对民权的回避。

source: Great answer. This addresses the concerns of law and order moderates and the Democratic base.
zh: 很好的答案。这解决了法律与秩序温和派和民主党基础的担忧。

source: This is a good, liberal answer but it might be a bridge too far in the climate of 1968.
zh: 这是一个很好的、自由主义的答案，但在 1968 年的气候下，它可能是一座太过遥远的桥梁。

source: Why are you attacking Medicare? This is a policy that is popular and something you have long backed.
zh: 你为什么攻击联邦医疗保险？这是一项很受欢迎的政策，也是你们长期以来支持的政策。

source: This is the best answer for the situation. It was the presumed answer though, so it has affected the polls minimally.
zh: 这是针对这种情况的最佳答案。不过，这是假定的答案，因此它对民意调查的影响微乎其微。

source: This is a good response, but you’re imitating Nixon and diminishing the booming economy of the Democrats, which deflates your core supporters.
zh: 这是一个很好的回应，但你正在模仿尼克松并削弱民主党蓬勃发展的经济，这让你的核心支持者感到沮丧。

source: Your embrace of the economy satisfies party bosses and brings the left back in line. At the same time, you lose support among independents as it ties yourself too close to the unpopular Johnson.
zh: 你对经济的支持让党的老板们感到满意，并使左翼重新站稳脚跟。同时，您会失去独立人士的支持，因为这将您与不受欢迎的人联系得太近约翰逊。

source: Economists agree that you have staked out a position on the liberal fringe of the economic debate. Although, your liberal economics and aversion to Vietnam helps as much it hurts, stabilizing the polls.
zh: 经济学家一致认为，您在经济辩论的自由主义边缘表明了立场。尽管如此，你的自由主义经济和对越南的厌恶也起到了一定作用，稳定了民意调查。

source: This is a good answer to win over white moderates, but it’s a disappointing answer to your party, especially blacks and liberals.
zh: 对于赢得白人温和派来说，这是一个很好的答案，但对于你的政党，尤其是黑人和自由派来说，这是一个令人失望的答案。

source: Good answer. This appeals to your base, which will lead to an increased liberal and black turnout. However, you’ve alarmed and lost moderates with your statements.
zh: 很好的答案。这对你的基础很有吸引力，这将导致自由派和黑人投票率的增加。然而，你的言论让温和派感到震惊并失去了支持者。

source: It’s valuable to stick by your morals, but America isn’t clamoring for aggressive integration.
zh: 坚持道德是很有价值的，但美国并没有大声疾呼积极的一体化。

source: Why would you not want to debate Nixon? He has an awkward, sometimes surly personality and you would surely look good in comparison.
zh: 为什么你不想辩论尼克松？他性格笨拙，有时甚至脾气暴躁，相比之下你肯定会看起来不错。

source: Nixon refuses to debate you, and most of the voters know it. This will definitely hurt him at the polls.
zh: 尼克松拒绝与你辩论，大多数选民都知道这一点。这肯定会在民意调查中伤害他。

source: After cajoling Nixon into a debate, you have absolutely trounced him. This could be a real turning point in your campaign, which started out looking so hopeless.
zh: 在哄骗尼克松进行辩论后，你已经彻底击败了他。这可能是你的竞选活动中真正的转折点，一开始看起来毫无希望。

source: Nixon agreed to debate you, but unfortunately he did not repeat his 1960 missteps. The inconclusive outcome does little to change the overall picture of the campaign.
zh: 尼克松同意和你辩论，但不幸的是他没有重蹈1960年的覆辙。不确定的结果对改变竞选的整体情况几乎没有作用。

source: You really can't win by choosing a side in the Chicago mayhem. Just move along and find other things to talk about.
zh: 在芝加哥的混乱中，你真的无法通过选择一方获胜。继续前进并找到其他可以谈论的事情。

source: It’s the best answer for the events that transpired in Chicago, but nobody is swayed by your rebuke of both sides.
zh: 这是对芝加哥发生的事件的最佳答案，但没有人会因为你对双方的谴责而动摇。

source: Total avoidance of the subject doesn’t do you any favors, although most Americans quickly move on from the situation.
zh: 完全回避这个话题对你没有任何好处，尽管大多数美国人很快就摆脱了这种情况。

source: This is a great answer if you want to lose the election.
zh: 如果您想输掉选举，这是一个很好的答案。

source: This plays towards moderate voters, but turns off the liberals of the Democratic party. You’ve deprived the base of their previous enthusiasm by being too cautious.
zh: 这对温和派选民有利，但却让民主党的自由派望而却步。你因为过于谨慎而剥夺了他们之前的热情。

source: Democratic moderates rejoice at your words, while the liberals fume and declare you no better than Nixon.
zh: 民主党温和派对你的话感到高兴，而自由派则愤怒并宣称你并不比尼克松更好。

source: Busing is unpopular, but you’ve pleased dedicated activists and grassroot supporters, who dedicate themselves into organizing and campaigning. Largely, your support has not changed.
zh: 公交车不受欢迎，但你让专注的活动家和草根支持者感到高兴，他们致力于组织和竞选活动。很大程度上，您的支持没有改变。

source: You’ve been fighting for civil rights your entire life, and now in a critical moment, you’re against it? Anyways, Democrats have revolted against you.
zh: 你毕生都在争取民权，如今到了关键关头，却反过来反对它？总之，民主党人已经纷纷倒戈。

source: Your response is a little cautious, so no damage will occur. However, no benefit will come from it also.
zh: 你的反应有点谨慎，所以不会发生任何损害。然而，它也不会带来任何好处。

source: The majority of white voters do not place police brutality as the cause of the long, hot summer. In terms of tradeoff, youth and black voters will turn out heavily for this fall.
zh: 大多数白人选民并不认为警察的暴行是造成漫长炎热夏季的原因。就权衡而言，今年秋天年轻人和黑人选民将大量投票。

source: Perhaps the media should stop asking you questions about Dr. King and instead your role in Nixon’s presidential transition.
zh: 也许媒体应该停止问你有关金博士的问题，而应该问你在尼克松总统过渡中的角色。

source: This is the standard, safe response.
zh: 这是标准的安全响应。

source: Scoring political points using Dr. King’s death is tone deaf, which negates any potential support you could have gained. However, many are animated by your speech, which prevents any slippage in the polls.
zh: 利用金博士的死来获得政治分数是无知的，这会否定你可能获得的任何潜在支持。然而，许多人都对你的演讲感到兴奋，这防止了民意调查出现任何下滑。

source: This was probably the worst answer you could give. You simultaneously anger Democrats and Negroes, and appear as a far-right extremist.
zh: 这可能是您能给出的最糟糕的答案。你同时激怒了民主党人和黑人，并以极右极端分子的形象出现。

source: This is the same answer your opposition has.
zh: 这与你的反对派的答案相同。

source: It’s the expected reply, so nothing really changes on the national stage.
zh: 这是预期的答复，因此国家舞台上没有任何真正的变化。

source: What were you thinking with this answer? You are the anti-war candidate and your rejection of detente has terrified doves about your position on Vietnam.
zh: 你对这个答案有什么想法？你是反战候选人，你对缓和的拒绝让鸽派对你在越南问题上的立场感到恐惧。

source: This is the more hawkish and cautious response.
zh: 这是更为鹰派和谨慎的回应。

source: You’ve affirmed your typical, realistic, but dovish stance.
zh: 你已经确认了你典型的、现实的、但鸽派的立场。

source: Incredibly idealistic, but it’s brought cheers from doves and the New Left.
zh: 令人难以置信的理想主义，但却带来了鸽派和新左派的欢呼。

source: When your advisors explained that you needed to be your own man and detach yourself from the unpopular Johnson, this is not what they were thinking.
zh: 当你的顾问解释说你需要做自己的人并让自己脱离不受欢迎的约翰逊时，他们并不是这么想的。

source: You sound suspiciously similar to Nixon. In fact, the black community has decried your new turn towards black capitalism.
zh: 你听起来与尼克松非常相似。事实上，黑人社区已经谴责了你们对黑人资本主义的新转变。

source: This was probably the best answer, as you manage to tackle the concerns of your big tent of voters.
zh: 这可能是最好的答案，因为您设法解决了一大群选民的担忧。

source: Lyndon calls you to inform that you have his complete support, securing the base. But a portion of moderates are spooked by your commitment to expanding the Great Society.
zh: 林登打电话给你，通知你得到他的全力支持，确保基地安全。但部分温和派对您扩大伟大社会的承诺感到震惊。

source: Major gains have been achieved in Texas, but voters sense your hesitancy towards Wallace. Polls across the nation have only been affected slightly.
zh: 得克萨斯州取得了重大进展，但选民感觉到您对华莱士犹豫不决。全国民意调查仅受到轻微影响。

source: Your offensive against Wallace nets you union boys, who are constantly reminded of “Wallace-land” and it's destitute working conditions.
zh: 你对华莱士的进攻让你的工会男孩们陷入困境，他们不断地提醒着“华莱士-土地”及其贫困的工作条件。

source: AFL-CIO leaders flex their power, cajoling Wallace-friendly union men. Your personal campaign scores big in liberal states, but less so in other areas.
zh: AFL-CIO 领导人展示他们的权力，哄骗华莱士友好的工会人员。你的个人竞选活动在自由主义国家得分很高，但在其他领域得分较低。

source: Many working-class Americans are convinced and impressed by the eloquence of your speech. This will definitely help you.
zh: 您雄辩的演讲令许多美国工人阶级信服并印象深刻。这绝对会对你有帮助。

source: Bad answer. Americans are not seeking an escalation of the war, and your constituents feel betrayed by your abrupt change towards Vietnam.
zh: 错误的答案。美国人并不寻求战争升级，而你们对越南态度的突然改变让你们的选民感到背叛。

source: Nothing you just said will be acceptable to the anti-war crowd. To make matters worse, data shows you have lost support.
zh: 你刚才所说的一切都不会被反战人群所接受。更糟糕的是，数据显示你已经失去了支持。

source: This is the best answer. Of course, it estranges the extreme doves, but most doves are in lockstep with your campaign. As a bonus, you coax a few moderates into supporting you.
zh: 这是最好的答案。当然，这会疏远极端的鸽派人士，但大多数鸽派人士都与你的竞选活动保持一致。作为奖励，你还可以说服一些温和派人士支持你。

source: In climate of ‘68, this is unreasonably dovish. And it’s generated easy attacks that you are weak against Communism, and at worst, a crypto-Communist.
zh: 在 68 年的气候下，这是不合理的鸽派。它很容易引发攻击，认为你对共产主义很弱，最坏的情况是，你是一个加密共产主义者。

source: The nation is not in the mood for more kids coming home in caskets.
zh: 这个国家没有心情让更多的孩子躺在棺材里回家。

source: This position is popular within your party, and Lyndon himself doesn’t disagree with it.
zh: 这个立场在你们党内很受欢迎，林登本人并不反对。

source: Way to flex foreign policy. With rumors of ongoing peace talks, this might legitimately become reality. You’ve inspired hope amongst the American people with your brave, idealistic stance.
zh: 灵活外交政策的方式。随着和平谈判正在进行的传言，这可能合法地成为现实。您以勇敢、理想主义的立场激发了美国人民的希望。

source: Winning over the anti-war crowd is crucial, but you’ve swung too far and alienated the mainstream population.
zh: 赢得反战人群的支持至关重要，但你太过分了，疏远了主流人群。

source: Pundits are surprised by your harsh tone towards the Reds, but it’s dissolved the constant claims relating you to Communism. It’s clear you’re no pushover.
zh: 专家们对你对红军的严厉语气感到惊讶，但这消除了有关你与共产主义的不断主张。很明显，你不是一个容易被打败的人。

source: This is the sensible answer that has an appeal to everyone. Well, everyone but the kooks.
zh: 这是对每个人都有吸引力的明智答案。好吧，除了怪人之外的所有人。

source: This is a great answer that reminds the nation of the fruitless endeavor that is Vietnam.
zh: 这是一个很好的答案，提醒全国人民越南的徒劳努力。

source: Your position is mocked for being by defense hawks for being delusional, and attacked by conservatives for being a “useful idiot.” But you’ve resonated with the country, who are tired of the war.
zh: 你的立场被国防鹰派嘲笑为妄想，并被保守派攻击为“有用的白痴”。但你引起了厌倦战争的国家的共鸣。

source: Observers believe that Israel launched a surprise attack first and question your logic. You’ve also gone against Johnson and the State Department on this issue.
zh: 观察家认为是以色列先发动突然袭击并质疑你的逻辑。您还在这个问题上反对约翰逊和国务院。

source: This is a good, broad answer that doesn’t alienate anyone.
zh: 这是一个很好、广泛的答案，不会疏远任何人。

source: This is a surprising anti-Israel answer coming from you, that hurts you marginally.
zh: 这是您提出的令人惊讶的反以色列答案，这对您造成了轻微的伤害。

source: You contradict your previous statements and earn the ire of American Jews.
zh: 你与之前的陈述相矛盾，并引起了美国犹太人的愤怒。

source: Democrats are stunned by your complete reversal, which won’t bode well for you this November.
zh: 民主党人对你的完全逆转感到震惊，这对今年 11 月的你来说不是好兆头。

source: Wasteful programs? Needless to say, the Democratic party is furious and angry calls fill up your offices.
zh: 浪费的公共项目？不用说，民主党人怒不可遏，抗议电话快把你的办公室打爆了。

source: This is the exact answer Johnson, the party, and the base was looking for.
zh: 这就是政党和基地正在寻找的确切答案约翰逊。

source: Being consistent is unquestionably important, but the extensive federal expansions you’re suggesting is frowned upon by most Americans.
zh: 保持一致无疑很重要，但您所建议的大规模联邦扩张遭到大多数美国人的反对。

source: You have taken the high road on this key issue, but it doesn't change the fact that peace talks have stalled. Sit down and watch the returns, and pray that you've done enough to pull out what would be an amazing comeback.
zh: 你们在这个关键问题上采取了强硬态度，但这并不能改变和平谈判陷入僵局的事实。坐下来观看选举结果，并祈祷你已经做了足够的努力来实现令人惊奇的东山再起。

source: The election closes in chaos. Peace talks collapse, you accuse Nixon, Nixon accuses the Democrats of bugging his plane, and the upshot is mass confusion and anger among the voters. Good luck tonight!
zh: 选举在混乱中结束。和谈破裂，你指责尼克松，尼克松指责民主党窃听他的飞机，结果是选民中的大规模混乱和愤怒。祝今晚好运！
